candidates.why: The strongest cheap-and-loud city option: September survey pricing put the whole group at $1,325 on the budget tier, with warm weather and low crowds. It fits Kai and Gabe’s nightlife and food interests; Priya gets less of the serious outdoors focus here.

A warm beach-and-city pick with food and nightlife, priced at $1,425 for the group in May’s survey, with no one over budget and lower crowds. It serves Maya’s warmth and beach ask alongside Kai and Gabe’s evening plans, though Priya’s hike-and-nature preference is less central.

A different kind of trip: mountains and outdoor time paired with nightlife, and the May survey put the group at $1,530 on the budget tier with no one over budget. May’s reported high is 75°F and crowds are low, giving Priya a more outdoors-forward choice while still offering Kai and Gabe city energy.

For Maya’s warm-water beach preference and the group’s food and nightlife interests, Cancún offers a warmer-weather, medium-haul option. The May survey priced the group at $2,990 on the budget tier with no one over budget; that higher total is the ask for the beach-focused change of scene.

An affordable, food-and-culture city option for Dev and Gabe, with a budget-tier group total of $1,295 in March’s survey and no one over budget. The reported high is 50°F, so this is the cooler-season city alternative rather than Maya’s warm-weather choice.
